saw_lines: High-end headphone buyers compare sound and comfort, and they want delivery and return terms before they add to cart.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a buyer scrolls past.
Your site offers 25% off the SILVA, yet 0 of 1 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new story ads.
